reader_summary.headline: Bottomless is a smart coffee subscription which automatically reorders coffee for you based on your consumption habits.
reader_summary.overview: Bottomless is a smart coffee subscription which automatically reorders coffee for you based on your consumption habits. You may remember Bottomless from Episode 124 when we had co-founder and CEO Michael Mayer on the show. I'm also a bottomless customer and like the service and idea so much I became an investor.

key_points.text: They send you a complimentary Wi-Fi scale with your first coffee order.
key_points.evidence_quote: They send you a complimentary Wi-Fi scale with your first coffee order.

key_points.text: Just set up the scale with your Wi-Fi, store your coffee on top, and then from that point forward.
key_points.evidence_quote: Just set up the scale with your Wi-Fi, store your coffee on top, and then from that point forward, bottomless sends you coffee at the perfect time with no additional effort.

key_points.text: The coffee itself is always roasted to order and shipped straight to you from a network of roasters across the country.
key_points.evidence_quote: The coffee itself is always roasted to order and shipped straight to you from a network of roasters across the country.

key_points.text: My favorite part about Bottomless is how the technology could be used for almost anything I buy regularly.
key_points.evidence_quote: My favorite part about Bottomless is how the technology could be used for almost anything I buy regularly.

thesis: The conversation explores how technological advancements have liberated entertainment from historical constraints, allowing for more immersive and expansive storytelling that mirrors ancient narrative forms. A key argument is the supremacy of intellectual property, specifically massive immersive fantasy worlds, which grow in value and reach as technology enables expression across multiple persistent mediums like video games, television, and comics.
